name: PancakeSwap / Cream Finance
rootCause: On March 15, 2021, PancakeSwap and Cream Finance users on BNB Chain and Ethereum Mainnet were redirected to phishing sites after attackers hijacked GoDaddy-managed DNS records. No smart contract compromise occurred, and direct loss figures remain unconfirmed. Attackers socially engineered GoDaddy support to update the DNS records for pancakeswap.finance and cream.finance, redirecting users to phishing sites that requested wallet seed phrases. The protocols’ backend and contracts were unaffected.
